versions.changelog:
Initial release of Codebase Argus – a portable, evidence-first agent playbook for codebase and CI workflow review.

- Enables multi-agent, evidence-driven review of GitHub PRs, CI failures, and downstream fork integration.
- Supports multiple review providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Codex), including multi-agent "tribunal" mode.
- Handles GitHub App webhooks and `/argus` PR comment commands for automated, rule-based PR and CI review.
- Provides structured autofix branch planning for safe, mechanical fixes.
- Focuses on security, audit, and test coverage in review findings; emphasizes non-intrusive, user-directed actions.
- Designed to work as an OpenClaw/ClawHub skill, with clear CLI usage, provider, and credential options.
